articles.summary: As AI transforms the procurement technology landscape, selecting the right solution has never been more critical. The Hackett Group® has released the Fall 2026 SolutionMap, evaluating 122 technology providers across 16 source‑to‑pay categories by using the industry’s most rigorous, evidence‑based assessment methodology. With more than 500 functional requirements, mandatory demos and verified customer value ratings, SolutionMap helps organizations cut through AI hype and make defensible technology choices. This latest release reinforces SolutionMap’s role as the gold standard for procurement technology evaluation – supporting faster shortlisting, clearer tradeoff analysis and greater confidence in build vs. buy decisions.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Releases Fall 2026 SolutionMap Evaluating 122 Procurement Technology Providers
